subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Look in a mirror and take your ______ with each step.
solution:
The correct answer is "time."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase** "take your time"** in this context suggests that the person should proceed slowly and not rush. (इस संदर्भ में वाक्यांश **"take your time"** सुझाव देता है कि व्यक्ति को धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़ना चाहिए और जल्दबाजी नहीं करनी चाहिए।)
 
• It implies a sense of careful consideration or deliberate movement, especially when looking in a mirror, where attention to detail might be important (e.g., while getting ready, applying makeup, or grooming).
 
• The use of** "time"** emphasizes the importance of being patient and thorough in the action of taking steps or performing tasks.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

**Correct sentence**: *Look in a mirror and take your **time**__ with each step.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Ages: **the length of time that somebody has lived or that something has existed. (उम्र, आयु, वय, अवधि)
 
• **Hostage: **a person who is caught and kept prisoner. A hostage may be killed or injured if the person who is holding him/her does not get what he/she is asking for. (पकड़ा जाकर बंदी बनाया गया व्‍यक्ति; बंधक (माँग पूरी न होने पर बंधक की हत्‍या तक की जा सकती है))
 
• **Plague: **any infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills many people. (तेज़ी से फैलने वाला कोई भी संक्रामक रोग जिससे बड़ी संख्‍या में रोगियों की मृत्‍यु हो जाती है)
